headline: Track AirVisual cloud air quality in Home Assistant
intro: Query the AirVisual cloud API for air quality data by latitude and longitude or by city, state, and country. The integration creates sensors for air quality index, pollution level, and main pollutant for each air quality standard.
highlights: Choose a location with coordinates or a city, state, and country
See an air quality index alongside its pollution level
Identify the pollutant with the highest current value

flow.title: From AirVisual location to air quality sensors
stages: Choose latitude and longitude or enter city, state, and country
Review the air quality index, pollution level, and main pollutant sensors
